# HighLevel API v3

> Index of HighLevel API version v3: 812 endpoints in 46 services. Base URL https://services.leadconnectorhq.com. Each service links a compact file with every endpoint of that service; each endpoint links its full markdown page.

- Send `Version: v3` on every request to use this version.
- This is the latest version; use it unless a specific older version is required.
- Full compact reference of this version in one file: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/llms/v3/llms-full.txt
